lec02bn-scene-u01.name: 稀疏依賴避開兩個極端

lec02bn-scene-u02.name: 父節點假設才真正省參數

lec02bn-scene-u03.name: DAG與機率表共同指定模型

lec02bn-scene-u04.name: 條件獨立不等於兩兩獨立

lec02bn-scene-u06.name: 醫療網路用六邊連七變數

lec02bn-frame-u01.name: lec02bn-frame-u01
lec02bn-frame-u01.text: 稀疏依賴避開兩個極端

lec02bn-u01-1-title.name: lec02bn-u01-1-title
lec02bn-u01-1-title.text: 聯合分布的參數快速爆炸

lec02bn-u01-1-body4.name: lec02bn-u01-1-body4
lec02bn-u01-1-body4.text:
每個二元特徵只取 0 或 1；共有 $2^l$ 種組合。
扣掉總和為 1 的限制。

lec02bn-u01-1-body5.name: lec02bn-u01-1-body5
lec02bn-u01-1-body5.text: No assumption: one probability for every combination; normalization removes one free value.

lec02bn-u01-2-title.name: lec02bn-u01-2-title
lec02bn-u01-2-title.text: 完全獨立雖省卻容易失真

lec02bn-u01-2-indt.name: lec02bn-u01-2-indt
lec02bn-u01-2-indt.text:
完全獨立
Full independence
只需 $l$ 個參數，但假設幾乎一定錯。

lec02bn-u01-2-jointt.name: lec02bn-u01-2-jointt
lec02bn-u01-2-jointt.text:
不做假設
No assumption
需 $2^l-1$ 個；高維時估不動。

lec02bn-u01-2-body5.name: lec02bn-u01-2-body5
lec02bn-u01-2-body5.text:
假設越多，參數越少，但越容易失真。
More assumptions save parameters, but may distort the truth.

lec02bn-u01-3-title.name: lec02bn-u01-3-title
lec02bn-u01-3-title.text: 同學比喻只說明關係稀疏

lec02bn-u01-3-body1.name: lec02bn-u01-3-body1
lec02bn-u01-3-body1.text:
六位同學：誰都不認識太簡略；列出所有關係組合太龐大。
只保留真有交情的關係。

lec02bn-u01-3-body2.name: lec02bn-u01-3-body2
lec02bn-u01-3-body2.text: Six classmates: keep only the real links, rather than erase all links or list every combination.

lec02bn-u01-3-warningt.name: lec02bn-u01-3-warningt
lec02bn-u01-3-warningt.text:
比喻侷限：認識沒有方向；貝氏網路的箭頭有方向。
Warning: knowing classmates is undirected; Bayesian-network arrows are directed.

lec02bn-frame-u02.name: lec02bn-frame-u02
lec02bn-frame-u02.text: 父節點假設才真正省參數

lec02bn-u02-1-body2.name: lec02bn-u02-1-body2
lec02bn-u02-1-body2.text:
$l$：變數數量；$x_i$：第 $i$ 個值；$p(x_i\mid\cdot)$：條件機率。
Any joint distribution factors with no independence assumption.

lec02bn-u02-2-title.name: lec02bn-u02-2-title
lec02bn-u02-2-title.text: 一步一步決定仍用全部前因

lec02bn-u02-2-body9.name: lec02bn-u02-2-body9
lec02bn-u02-2-body9.text:
先定 $x_1$，再決定 $x_2$，依此類推；每步仍使用前面所有變數。
Fix one variable at a time; each factor still conditions on every earlier variable.

lec02bn-u02-3-title.name: lec02bn-u02-3-title
lec02bn-u02-3-title.text: 只依賴父集合才省參數

lec02bn-u02-3-wrongt.name: lec02bn-u02-3-wrongt
lec02bn-u02-3-wrongt.text:
✗ 鏈鎖規則本身已簡化。
False: the chain rule alone saves parameters.

lec02bn-u02-3-rightt.name: lec02bn-u02-3-rightt
lec02bn-u02-3-rightt.text:
✓ 真正省的是「只依賴 $A_i$」。
The parent-subset assumption is what saves parameters.

lec02bn-u02-3-body6.name: lec02bn-u02-3-body6
lec02bn-u02-3-body6.text: $\mathbf{x}$ 是全部特徵向量；$A_i$ 是父節點集合。

lec02bn-frame-u03.name: lec02bn-frame-u03
lec02bn-frame-u03.text: DAG與機率表共同指定模型

lec02bn-u03-1-title.name: lec02bn-u03-1-title
lec02bn-u03-1-title.text: 六節點網路有兩根六邊

lec02bn-u03-1-subtitle.name: lec02bn-u03-1-subtitle
lec02bn-u03-1-subtitle.text: Directed acyclic graph: arrows never return to their start

lec02bn-u03-1-body20.name: lec02bn-u03-1-body20
lec02bn-u03-1-body20.text:
節點＝變數；邊＝父指向子。
根節點 $x_1,x_2$ 沒有父節點。
Nodes are variables; edges point parent to child.

lec02bn-u03-1-body21.name: lec02bn-u03-1-body21
lec02bn-u03-1-body21.text:
無環：沿箭頭不能回原點。
Acyclic: no directed return path.

lec02bn-u03-2-rootst.name: lec02bn-u03-2-rootst
lec02bn-u03-2-rootst.text:
根節點／Roots
$p(x_1),p(x_2)$
沒有父節點，用邊際機率。
Marginal probabilities.

lec02bn-u03-2-cptt.name: lec02bn-u03-2-cptt
lec02bn-u03-2-cptt.text:
其餘節點／Non-roots
$p(x_i\mid A_i)$
每個父組合都需一個條件機率。
A CPT for every parent setting.

lec02bn-u03-2-body5.name: lec02bn-u03-2-body5
lec02bn-u03-2-body5.text:
拓樸排序讓每條箭頭向前；無環保證存在。
Topological order lets us multiply from roots downward without going back.

lec02bn-u03-3-title.name: lec02bn-u03-3-title
lec02bn-u03-3-title.text: 六個因子組成聯合機率

lec02bn-u03-3-body3.name: lec02bn-u03-3-body3
lec02bn-u03-3-body3.text:
每個因子的條件就是圖上的父節點。
Each factor conditions exactly on the parents shown by the arrows.

lec02bn-u03-4-body2.name: lec02bn-u03-4-body2
lec02bn-u03-4-body2.text:
根：0.3、0.6。其餘為已指定父節點皆取 1 時的條件機率。
The non-root bars are conditional on the stated parents being 1.

lec02bn-u03-4-body4.name: lec02bn-u03-4-body4
lec02bn-u03-4-body4.text:
講義記述：完整表的 64 種組合加總為 1。
Lecture reports normalization over all 64 settings.

lec02bn-frame-u04.name: lec02bn-frame-u04
lec02bn-frame-u04.text: 條件獨立不等於兩兩獨立

lec02bn-u04-1-title.name: lec02bn-u04-1-title
lec02bn-u04-1-title.text: 看到中介才沒有額外資訊

lec02bn-u04-1-body10.name: lec02bn-u04-1-body10
lec02bn-u04-1-body10.text:
$x_2$ 承接全部影響；知道它後，$x_1$ 不再解釋 $x_3$。
Once the middle node is known, x1 adds no information about x3.

lec02bn-u04-2-title.name: lec02bn-u04-2-title
lec02bn-u04-2-title.text: 中介未揭露時兩端仍相關

lec02bn-u04-2-body4.name: lec02bn-u04-2-body4
lec02bn-u04-2-body4.text: Knowing x1 changes the chance of x3: 0.74 versus 0.26. They are not marginally independent.

lec02bn-u04-3-title.name: lec02bn-u04-3-title
lec02bn-u04-3-title.text: 給定中介後同組機率相等

lec02bn-u04-3-conditional-chart.name: conditional-chart
lec02bn-u04-3-conditional-chart.text: At x2=1 both bars are 0.80; at x2=0 both bars are 0.20

image.alt: At x2=1 both bars are 0.80; at x2=0 both bars are 0.20

lec02bn-u04-3-body3.name: lec02bn-u04-3-body3
lec02bn-u04-3-body3.text: Within a known x2 setting, changing x1 cannot change the answer.

lec02bn-u04-4-title.name: lec02bn-u04-4-title
lec02bn-u04-4-title.text: 條件獨立不代表原本獨立

lec02bn-u04-4-body1.name: lec02bn-u04-4-body1
lec02bn-u04-4-body1.text:
「已知 $x_2$ 後獨立」
不等於「兩者獨立」。

lec02bn-u04-4-motto.name: lec02bn-u04-4-motto
lec02bn-u04-4-motto.text:
Independent given x2
is not the same as independent.

lec02bn-u05-1-title.name: lec02bn-u05-1-title
lec02bn-u05-1-title.text: 父節點數決定每張表大小

lec02bn-u05-1-body3.name: lec02bn-u05-1-body3
lec02bn-u05-1-body3.text:
二元節點每個父組合只估一個機率；另一個由總和為 1 決定。
One probability per parent setting.

lec02bn-u05-3-title.name: lec02bn-u05-3-title
lec02bn-u05-3-title.text: 稀疏模型保留中間甜區

lec02bn-u05-3-body3.name: lec02bn-u05-3-body3
lec02bn-u05-3-body3.text:
真實依賴常稀疏；抹掉所有邊才開始痛。
Sparse real links are the sweet spot.

lec02bn-u05-4-title.name: lec02bn-u05-4-title
lec02bn-u05-4-title.text: 同樣六節點可由疏變密

lec02bn-u05-4-body61.name: lec02bn-u05-4-body61
lec02bn-u05-4-body61.text:
完全獨立抹去所有邊；貝氏網路保留真正相關的邊。
Independence erases every link; the BN preserves sparse dependencies.

lec02bn-u05-5-sourcet.name: lec02bn-u05-5-sourcet
lec02bn-u05-5-sourcet.text:
來源寫「13 個」，且說 $A_1$ 不需要、$x_1$ 是根。
The original source reports 13 and identifies x1 as a root.

lec02bn-u05-5-lecturet.name: lec02bn-u05-5-lecturet
lec02bn-u05-5-lecturet.text:
本講義採 14：根 $x_1$ 的邊際機率也要估。
This lecture uses 14, including the marginal probability of x1.

lec02bn-u05-5-body5.name: lec02bn-u05-5-body5
lec02bn-u05-5-body5.text:
保留差異，待老師核對。
Discrepancy retained for the teacher’s confirmation.

lec02bn-frame-u06.name: lec02bn-frame-u06
lec02bn-frame-u06.text: 醫療網路用六邊連七變數

lec02bn-u06-1-title.name: lec02bn-u06-1-title
lec02bn-u06-1-title.text: 吸菸連疾病疾病連檢測

lec02bn-u06-1-body21.name: lec02bn-u06-1-body21
lec02bn-u06-1-body21.text:
$S$ 吸菸／Smoking；$C$ 肺癌／Cancer；$H$ 心臟病／Heart disease。
$C_1,C_2$ 肺癌檢測；$H_1,H_2$ 心臟病檢測。

lec02bn-u06-2-title.name: lec02bn-u06-2-title
lec02bn-u06-2-title.text: 二成是給定吸菸的肺癌率

lec02bn-u06-2-body3.name: lec02bn-u06-2-body3
lec02bn-u06-2-body3.text:
示範數字，不是原圖或臨床統計。
Illustrative number, not original-figure or clinical data.

lec02bn-u06-3-body2.name: lec02bn-u06-3-body2
lec02bn-u06-3-body2.text:
七個節點只用六條邊，對應稀疏 CPT 集合。
同一病因可由多項檢查共同支持。

lec02bn-u06-3-body3.name: lec02bn-u06-3-body3
lec02bn-u06-3-body3.text: Seven nodes, six arrows rather than 21. Several checks can support the same cause.

lec02bn-u06-4-title.name: lec02bn-u06-4-title
lec02bn-u06-4-title.text: 清空父集合就成完全獨立

lec02bn-u06-4-bnt.name: lec02bn-u06-4-bnt
lec02bn-u06-4-bnt.text:
貝氏網路／BN
$A_i\subseteq\{\text{前面的變數}\}$
只保留圖上依賴。

lec02bn-u06-4-nbt.name: lec02bn-u06-4-nbt
lec02bn-u06-4-nbt.text:
完全獨立／Naive Bayes
$A_i=\emptyset$
所有特徵彼此獨立。

lec02bn-u06-4-body6.name: lec02bn-u06-4-body6
lec02bn-u06-4-body6.text:
完全聯合分布則不做任何獨立假設。
The full joint distribution makes no independence assumption.

lec02bn-u06-5-title.name: lec02bn-u06-5-title
lec02bn-u06-5-title.text: 稀疏依賴是全講的關鍵

lec02bn-u06-5-body1.name: lec02bn-u06-5-body1
lec02bn-u06-5-body1.text:
鏈鎖規則不省；父集合才省。
DAG 配 CPT 指定聯合分布。
條件獨立不是兩兩獨立。
六個二元特徵：6、14、63。

lec02bn-u06-5-body2.name: lec02bn-u06-5-body2
lec02bn-u06-5-body2.text:
Chain rule • parent set • DAG • CPT • joint distribution
Conditional vs marginal independence • topological order
Curse of dimensionality • sparse dependency • sweet spot
